alt: A T-Mobile customer requests an Executive Manual Unlock Override for a Moto G Power 2025 phone that remains locked due to a 40-day usage policy despite a refund, warning of escalation to the FCC and BBB if the IMEI is not whitelisted.
summary: A T-Mobile customer requests an Executive Manual Unlock Override for a Moto G Power 2025 phone that remains locked due to a 40-day usage policy despite a refund, warning of escalation to the FCC and BBB if the IMEI is not whitelisted.
full_text: The sender explains that they were misled at a T-Mobile retail location and that although a refund was issued, the Moto G Power 2025 remains locked due to a 40‑day usage policy. The email requests an Executive Manual Unlock Override and warns of escalation to the FCC and BBB if the IMEI is not manually whitelisted. The message references prior attempts to resolve the issue with T-Mobile support.
